entries.en: Added `/config key=value` syntax to set any setting from the prompt (e.g. `/config thinking=false`) — works in interactive, `-p`, and Remote Control
entries.zh: 添加了`/config key=value`语法以通过提示设置任何设置（例如“/configthinking=false”）——适用于交互、`-p`和远程控制

entries.en: Added `sandbox.allowAppleEvents` opt-in setting that lets sandboxed commands send Apple Events on macOS
entries.zh: 添加了`sandbox.allowAppleEvents`选择加入设置，允许沙盒命令在 macOS 上发送 Apple 事件

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE` environment variable: point it at a marker file to suppress mobile push notifications while you're at the machine
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE`环境变量：将其指向标记文件以在您在计算机上时抑制移动推送通知

entries.en: Upgraded the bundled Bun runtime to 1.4
entries.zh: 内置 Bun 运行时升级到 1.4

entries.en: Improved streaming of long paragraphs: text now appears line-by-line instead of waiting for the first line break
entries.zh: 改进长段落的流式输出：文字逐行显示，不再等到第一个换行符才出现

entries.en: Improved auto-retry: API connection drops mid-thinking now automatically retry instead of showing "Connection closed while thinking"
entries.zh: 改进自动重试：API 连接在思考过程中断开时，现在会自动重试，不再显示“Connection closed while thinking”

entries.en: Improved the subagent panel: idle subagents auto-hide after 30s, the list caps at 5 rows with scroll hints, and keyboard hints now show in the footer
entries.zh: 改进子智能体面板：空闲的子智能体 30 秒后自动隐藏，列表最多显示 5 行并带滚动提示，键盘快捷键提示显示在底部

entries.en: Improved the MCP OAuth browser page to match Claude Code's visual style and auto-close on success
entries.zh: 改进 MCP OAuth 浏览器页面：视觉风格与 Claude Code 一致，成功后自动关闭

entries.en: Changed fullscreen mode URL opening to require Cmd+click (macOS) / Ctrl+click, matching native terminal behavior
entries.zh: 将全屏模式 URL 打开更改为需要 Cmd+click (macOS) / Ctrl+click，匹配本机终端行为

entries.en: Changed the `Improved N memories` line to no longer list individual files outside verbose mode
entries.zh: 更改了“改进的 N 个内存”行，不再列出详细模式之外的单个文件

entries.en: Fixed prompt caching not reading on custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and on Foundry due to a per-request attestation token changing every turn
entries.zh: 修复了由于每个请求的证明令牌每回合都在变化而导致提示缓存无法在自定义`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`和 Foundry 上读取的问题

entries.en: Fixed Write/Edit producing 0-byte or truncated files on network drives and cloud-synced folders
entries.zh: 修复了写入/编辑在网络驱动器和云同步文件夹上生成 0 字节或截断文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed `open`, `osascript`, and browser-based auth flows failing with error -600 on macOS by adding the Apple Events entitlement
entries.zh: 通过添加 Apple Events 权利，修复了 macOS 上`open`、`osascript`和基于浏览器的身份验证流程失败并出现错误 -600 的问题

entries.en: Fixed a startup regression (~120ms per launch in fresh environments, introduced in 2.1.169): the first prompt no longer waits for the managed-settings fetch when no MCP servers are configured
entries.zh: 修复了启动回归（在新环境中每次启动约 120 毫秒，在 2.1.169 中引入）：当未配置 MCP 服务器时，第一个提示不再等待托管设置获取

entries.en: Fixed startup blocking with a blank terminal for up to 15 seconds when the account settings fetch is slow on a degraded network
entries.zh: 修复了在降级网络上帐户设置获取速度缓慢时，空白终端的启动阻塞长达 15 秒的问题

entries.en: Fixed startup crash (`TypeError: Cannot read properties of null`) when `.claude.json` contains corrupted null project entries
entries.zh: 修复了当`.claude.json`包含损坏的空项目条目时启动崩溃（“TypeError：无法读取 null 的属性”）

entries.en: Fixed macOS TUI freezing at session start (Ctrl+C unresponsive) when Spotlight is busy reindexing
entries.zh: 修复了当 Spotlight 忙于重新索引时 macOS TUI 在会话开始时冻结（Ctrl+C 无响应）的问题

entries.en: Fixed long-running idle sessions losing their history when another Claude Code process ran the 30-day transcript cleanup
entries.zh: 修复了当另一个 Claude Code 进程运行 30 天的记录清理时，长时间运行的空闲会话会丢失历史记录的问题

entries.en: Fixed foreground subagents spawning unbounded nested chains; they now respect the same 5-level depth limit as background subagents
entries.zh: 修复了前景子代理产生无界嵌套链的问题；他们现在遵循与后台子代理相同的 5 级深度限制

entries.en: Fixed `/recap` and conversation forks using the previous model immediately after a model switch
entries.zh: 修复了模型切换后立即使用先前模型的`/recap`和对话分支

entries.en: Fixed subagent "Thinking" duration showing the parent agent's elapsed time instead of the subagent's own
entries.zh: 修复了子代理“思考”持续时间，显示父代理的已用时间而不是子代理自己的时间

entries.en: Fixed subagents blocked on a nested agent showing a ticking elapsed time instead of "waiting" in the agent panel
entries.zh: 修复了嵌套代理上被阻止的子代理，显示滴答流逝的时间，而不是在代理面板中“等待”

entries.en: Fixed the API retry indicator ("Retrying in 0s · attempt N/10") staying on screen after the retry succeeded
entries.zh: 修复了重试成功后 API 重试指示器（“0 秒内重试·尝试 N/10”）停留在屏幕上的问题

entries.en: Fixed AWS `awsCredentialExport` credentials with a short remaining lifetime causing credential refreshes every minute, and now accepts the JSON shape from `aws configure export-credentials`
entries.zh: 修复了剩余生命周期较短的 AWS `awsCredentialExport` 凭证，导致凭证每分钟刷新一次，现在接受来自 `aws configure export-credentials` 的 JSON 形状

entries.en: Fixed `claude mcp get`/`list` showing `✓ Connected` when tools/list fails; they now show `! Connected · tools fetch failed` with the error detail
entries.zh: 修复了当工具/列表失败时`claude mcp get`/`list`显示“✓已连接”的问题；他们现在展示`！已连接·工具获取失败`并显示错误详细信息

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-control` leaving a stale "connecting…" line; it now confirms in the transcript once connected
entries.zh: 修复了`/remote-control`留下陈旧的“正在连接…”行的问题；一旦连接，它现在会在记录中确认

entries.en: Fixed ExitWorktree refusing to remove a clean worktree with "Could not verify worktree state" when bare `git` cannot be resolved on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了当 Windows 上无法解析裸露的 `git` 时，ExitWorktree 拒绝删除干净的工作树并显示“无法验证工作树状态”的问题

entries.en: Fixed settings changes (such as `/effort` or `/model`) failing with ENOENT when `~/.claude/settings.json` is a relative symlink under a symlinked `~/.claude`
entries.zh: 修复了当`~/.claude/settings.json`是符号链接`~/.claude`下的相对符号链接时，设置更改（例如`/effort`或`/model`）因 ENOENT 失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed IDE selection line numbers in context reminders being off by one (IntelliJ and VS Code)
entries.zh: 修复了上下文提醒中的 IDE 选择行号减一的问题（IntelliJ 和 VS Code）

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+C in fullscreen after a native terminal selection (modifier+drag) overwriting the clipboard with the app's prior selection
entries.zh: 修复了本机终端选择（修改器+拖动）后全屏使用 Ctrl+C 使用应用程序之前的选择覆盖剪贴板的问题

entries.en: Fixed Ctrl+V showing "No image found in clipboard" instead of pasting when the clipboard contains text
entries.zh: 修复了当剪贴板包含文本时 Ctrl+V 显示“剪贴板中找不到图像”而不是粘贴的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent creation failing with "EEXIST: file already exists" when the agents directory already exists (Windows/OneDrive)
entries.zh: 修复了代理目录已存在时创建代理失败并显示“EEXIST：文件已存在”的问题 (Windows/OneDrive)

entries.en: Fixed AskUserQuestion preview content being cut off at the dialog edge instead of word-wrapping
entries.zh: 修复了 AskUserQuestion 预览内容在对话框边缘被切断而不是自动换行的问题

entries.en: Fixed AskUserQuestion multi-select questions silently dropping a typed "Other" free-text answer when submitting
entries.zh: 修复了 AskUserQuestion 多选问题在提交时无提示地丢弃键入的“其他”自由文本答案的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/stats` "Most active day" and daily token chart dates showing one day early in UTC-negative timezones
entries.zh: 修复了`/stats`“最活跃日”和每日代币图表日期在 UTC 负时区中早一天显示的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/copy` and copy-on-select on Linux not detecting a clipboard utility installed after Claude Code started
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux 上的`/copy`和选择复制未检测到 Claude Code 启动后安装的剪贴板实用程序的问题

entries.en: Fixed tab-indented code rendering with incorrect indentation in the Write (create-file) preview
entries.zh: 修复 Write（创建文件）预览中，带 Tab 缩进的代码缩进显示错误的问题

entries.en: Fixed user prompts queued mid-turn not showing a full-width background highlight in the transcript
entries.zh: 修复回合中途排队的用户提示，在转录中没有全宽背景高亮的问题

entries.en: Fixed the activity spinner's pulse dwelling on the wrong glyph size in Ghostty
entries.zh: 修复 Ghostty 中活动旋转指示器的脉动停留在错误字形大小上的问题
